cards.name: Rat
cards.rules: Reveal: summon a Rat here.
cards.flavor: Where there is one, the cellar has a hundred.

cards.name: Giant Bat
cards.rules: End of turn: move this to the next holding round the table with room.
cards.flavor: It never stays where your torch is.

cards.name: Giant Scorpion
cards.rules: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: The Alik'r sends its regards on eight legs.

cards.name: Spriggan
cards.rules: Reveal: your units here gain +1 power.
cards.flavor: The wood mends what stands beside it.

cards.name: Harpy
cards.rules: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.
cards.flavor: Its shriek reaches every man in the hall.

cards.name: Nymph
cards.rules: Reveal: draw a card.
cards.flavor: She tells you a secret, and you forget your sword.

cards.name: Centaur
cards.rules: Ongoing: your beast units here have +1 power.
cards.flavor: The herds of the hills answer its horn.

cards.name: Dreugh
cards.rules: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: The Bay's floor walks up onto the strand.

cards.name: Lamia
cards.rules: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 2 power.
cards.flavor: She sings the bravest down first.

cards.name: Gargoyle
cards.rules: Reveal: your weakest unit here gains +2 power.
cards.flavor: Stone keeps watch over the soft.

cards.name: Werewolf
cards.rules: End of turn: this gains +1 power.
cards.flavor: Every night a little less of the man.

cards.name: Wereboar
cards.rules: Reveal: your beast units here gain +1 power.
cards.flavor: Hircine's other children run with it.

cards.name: Dragonling
cards.rules: Reveal: enemy units here lose 2 power.
cards.flavor: Small, for a dragon. Not small for a hall.

cards.name: Giant
cards.rules: Reveal: units here lose 1 power.
cards.flavor: Where it steps, friend and foe alike are trodden.

cards.name: Grizzly Bear
cards.rules: End of turn: this loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: It comes down the Wrothgarian pass at a charge, and it does not charge twice.

cards.name: Sabretooth Tiger
cards.rules: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: It goes for the biggest throat in the hall.

cards.name: Spider
cards.rules: Ongoing: enemy units here that cost 1 or 2 have -1 power.
cards.flavor: The small walk into its web; the large walk through it.

cards.name: Slaughterfish
cards.rules: End of turn: this loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: Out of the water, it has one good bite in it.

cards.name: Skeletal Warrior
cards.rules: Ongoing: your undead units here have +1 power.
cards.flavor: They rise in ranks, as they fell.

cards.name: Zombie
cards.rules: End of turn: this loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: Strong, for now. It is coming apart.

cards.name: Ghost
cards.rules: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 2 power.
cards.flavor: The bravest feel the cold first.

cards.name: Wraith
cards.rules: Ongoing: enemy units here have -1 power.
cards.flavor: While it lingers, no fire burns warm.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.rules: End of turn: this gains +1 power.
cards.flavor: It has all night, and every night after.

cards.name: Ancient Vampire
cards.rules: End of turn: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power and this gains +1 power.
cards.flavor: The bloodlines of the Bay all lead back to one cellar.

cards.name: Lich
cards.rules: Ongoing: your undead units here have +1 power.
cards.flavor: It traded its death for a library.

cards.name: Ancient Lich
cards.rules: Reveal: destroy the weakest enemy unit here. Ongoing: your undead units have +1 power.
cards.flavor: It remembers the First Era as you remember breakfast.

cards.name: Mummy
cards.rules: End of turn: your weakest undead unit here gains +1 power.
cards.flavor: Wrapped for the long dark, and patient in it.

cards.name: Imp
cards.rules: Reveal: gain +1 magicka next turn.
cards.flavor: A small spite with a full purse of magicka.

cards.name: Daedra Seducer
cards.rules: Reveal: turn the weakest enemy unit here into a Rat.
cards.flavor: Look her in the eye and see what you were.

cards.name: Daedroth
cards.rules: End of turn: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: Its jaws close on the slowest.

cards.name: Daedra Lord
cards.rules: Reveal: summon an Imp here.
cards.flavor: It never comes through the gate alone.

cards.name: Fire Atronach
cards.rules: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.
cards.flavor: The room is warm. Then it is ash.

cards.name: Ice Atronach
cards.rules: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 2 power.
cards.flavor: The weak freeze where they stand.

cards.name: Flesh Atronach
cards.rules: Ongoing: your atronach units here have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Stitched from what the summoner had to hand.

cards.name: Iron Atronach
cards.rules: Ongoing: your atronach units have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Iron given a will by a mage's binding, and it does not tire.

cards.name: Frost Daedra
cards.rules: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.
cards.flavor: Where it walks, the ale freezes in the cup.

cards.name: Fire Daedra
cards.rules: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 2 power.
cards.flavor: Its blade was forged in the Deadlands, and it is burning still.

cards.name: Orc
cards.rules: Ongoing: your orc units here have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Never the only one in the pass.

cards.name: Orc Sergeant
cards.rules: Reveal: your orc units here gain +1 power.
cards.flavor: It shouts, and the line stands.

cards.name: Orc Shaman
cards.rules: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 2 power.
cards.flavor: Malacath's curses carry well in cold air.

cards.name: Orc Warlord
cards.rules: Ongoing: your orc units have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Gortwog dreams of a city. This one dreams of a war.

cards.name: Mages Guild Apprentice
cards.rules: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: Her first spark, and she aimed it well.

cards.name: Mages Guild Battlemage
cards.rules: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.
cards.flavor: The guild teaches lightning to the dues-paid.

cards.name: Mages Guild Archmage
cards.rules: Reveal: draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Every book in the hall, and the ones not on the shelves.

cards.name: Fighters Guild Swordsman
cards.rules: Ongoing: your warrior units here have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Paid by the contract, loyal to the man beside him.

cards.name: Fighters Guild Champion
cards.rules: Reveal: your warrior units here gain +2 power.
cards.flavor: The guildhall's best blade, and its loudest voice.

cards.name: Thieves Guild Filcher
cards.rules: Reveal: draw a card.
cards.flavor: Your purse was lighter than you thought.

cards.name: Thieves Guild Crook
cards.rules: Reveal: gain +2 magicka next turn.
cards.flavor: No questions, half the price.

cards.name: Dark Brotherhood Assassin
cards.rules: Reveal: destroy the weakest enemy unit here.
cards.flavor: The contract was signed before you sat down.

cards.name: Nightblade
cards.rules: End of turn: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: A blade you only see in the morning.

cards.name: Priest of Arkay
cards.rules: Reveal: destroy the weakest enemy undead unit here.
cards.flavor: Arkay keeps the cycle. The dead go back.

cards.name: Priest of Stendarr
cards.rules: Reveal: your units here gain +1 power.
cards.flavor: Mercy, laid on with both hands.

cards.name: Priest of Dibella
cards.rules: Reveal: draw a card.
cards.flavor: Beauty opens doors a key will not.

cards.name: Priest of Julianos
cards.rules: Reveal: gain +1 magicka next turn.
cards.flavor: Logic, applied, is a kind of magicka.

cards.name: Priest of Kynareth
cards.rules: Reveal: move your weakest unit here to the next holding round the table with room.
cards.flavor: The wind carries the faithful where they are needed.

cards.name: Priest of Mara
cards.rules: Ongoing: your units here have +1 power.
cards.flavor: While she prays, no one here stands alone.

cards.name: Priest of Zenithar
cards.rules: Reveal: gain +2 magicka next turn.
cards.flavor: Work honestly, and the god of trade pays honestly.

cards.name: Priest of Akatosh
cards.rules: End of turn: your weakest unit here gains +1 power.
cards.flavor: Time favors the patient.

cards.name: Knight of the Dragon
cards.rules: Ongoing: your knight units here have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Daggerfall's order rides together or not at all.

cards.name: Knight of the Wheel
cards.rules: End of turn: this gains +1 power.
cards.flavor: The Order of the Wheel turns, and its knights grow with every turning.

cards.name: Host of the Horn
cards.rules: Reveal: your units here gain +1 power.
cards.flavor: One blast, and the whole line takes heart.

cards.name: Knight of the Rose
cards.rules: Reveal: draw a card.
cards.flavor: Wayrest's knights carry letters as well as lances.

cards.name: Knight of the Flame
cards.rules: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 2 power.
cards.flavor: They ride at the biggest thing on the field.

cards.name: King Gothryd
cards.rules: Ongoing: your knight units have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Daggerfall's young king, and every knight in it is his.

cards.name: Archer
cards.rules: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: One arrow, for the one who cannot dodge it.

cards.name: Ranger
cards.rules: Reveal: the strongest enemy beast unit here loses 2 power.
cards.flavor: The wilds have one law, and the ranger keeps it.

cards.name: Frostbite
cards.rules: The weakest enemy unit here loses 2 power.
cards.flavor: The weak go numb first.

cards.name: Shock
cards.rules: Enemy units here lose 1 power.
cards.flavor: It jumps from man to man.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.rules: The strongest enemy unit here loses 3 power.
cards.flavor: Aim at the biggest. You will not miss.

cards.name: Heal
cards.rules: Your weakest unit here gains +2 power.
cards.flavor: Up, soldier. Not yet.

cards.name: Recall
cards.rules: Move your strongest unit here to the next holding round the table with room.
cards.flavor: Here a moment ago. Needed elsewhere.

cards.name: Turn Undead
cards.rules: Destroy the weakest enemy undead unit here.
cards.flavor: Back into the earth, by Arkay's leave.

cards.name: Banish Daedra
cards.rules: Destroy the weakest enemy daedra unit here.
cards.flavor: Back through the gate that let it in, and the gate shut behind it.

cards.name: Animate Dead
cards.rules: Summon a Zombie here.
cards.flavor: The graveyard is a barracks, if you know the words.

cards.name: Mehrunes' Razor
cards.rules: Destroy the strongest enemy unit here.
cards.flavor: One cut, and the greatest falls.

cards.name: Wabbajack
cards.rules: Turn the strongest enemy unit here into a Rat.
cards.flavor: Sheogorath thinks this is very funny.

cards.name: Azura's Star
cards.rules: Draw 2 cards and gain +2 magicka next turn.
cards.flavor: A soul gem that never empties.

cards.name: Oghma Infinium
cards.rules: Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: Hermaeus Mora lends it. He never forgets the loan.

cards.name: Chrysamere
cards.rules: Your strongest unit here gains +4 power.
cards.flavor: The Paladin's Blade chooses the worthy.

cards.name: Sanguine Rose
cards.rules: Summon a Daedroth here.
cards.flavor: Each thorn a door, and something comes through.

cards.name: Mehrunes Dagon
cards.rules: Ongoing: enemy units have -1 power.
cards.flavor: The Prince of Destruction asks nothing. He takes.

cards.name: Molag Bal
cards.rules: Ongoing: your undead units have +2 power.
cards.flavor: The Lord of Domination asks no bargain. He takes the bound and keeps them.

cards.name: Sanguine
cards.rules: Ongoing: your units that cost 1 or 2 have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Every tavern is his temple, and the small folk drink free.

cards.name: Hircine
cards.rules: Ongoing: your beast units have +2 power.
cards.flavor: The Huntsman runs with his pack.

cards.name: Nocturnal
cards.rules: Reveal: draw a card. Ongoing: your thief units have +2 power.
cards.flavor: The Night Mistress keeps her own in shadow.

cards.name: Clavicus Vile
cards.rules: Ongoing: your spells cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: A bargain. Read the small print later.

cards.name: Namira
cards.rules: Ongoing: enemy units that cost 4 or more have -2 power.
cards.flavor: The Spurned pull down the proud.

cards.name: Boethiah
cards.rules: Ongoing: your warrior units have +2 power.
cards.flavor: The Prince of Plots favors whoever is still standing.

cards.name: Azura
cards.rules: Ongoing: your units have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Dusk and dawn, and every one of hers between.

cards.name: Malacath
cards.rules: Ongoing: your orc units have +2 power.
cards.flavor: The god of curses remembers every orc by name.

cards.name: Meridia
cards.rules: Ongoing: enemy undead units have -2 power.
cards.flavor: Her light finds the dead wherever they hide.

cards.name: Valkynaz Ruhn
cards.rules: Reveal: destroy the weakest enemy unit here.
cards.flavor: Warden of the Burning Gate. He was set to hold it, and he holds it.

cards.name: Sethrakul
cards.rules: End of turn: enemy units here lose 1 power.
cards.flavor: The Old Coil rises where the packet lanes run deep.

cards.name: Brass Remnant
cards.rules: End of turn: this gains +1 power.
cards.flavor: It keeps the Hour in the Abyss. Every turn of the Hour turns it harder.

cards.name: Grath, the Hound
cards.rules: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit here loses 3 power.
cards.flavor: The Kyn loosed him on the Galleries. The bridges still smoke where he ran.

cards.name: The Last Spellmaster
cards.rules: Reveal: draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: He sets the Examination still. Nobody has passed it since 3E 398.

cards.name: The Last Armsmaster
cards.rules: Ongoing: your warrior units here have +2 power.
cards.flavor: Raised by the Kyn, he still teaches the sword. The lesson is the same.

cards.name: Valkynaz Ilthys
cards.rules: Reveal: your daedra units gain +1 power.
cards.flavor: She took the Galleries in a night, and burned the banners she did not keep.

cards.name: The Cairn-Keeper
cards.rules: Reveal: gain +2 magicka next turn.
cards.flavor: Every soul pays the tithe. The Keeper counts them all.

cards.name: The Twin Lords
cards.rules: Reveal: your units here gain +1 power.
cards.flavor: Vael and Isk. Strike one, and the other remembers it.

cards.name: Valkynaz Morvayn
cards.rules: End of turn: the strongest enemy unit here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: He chains the souls of the Cairn, and wears them.

cards.name: The Mother of Dusk
cards.rules: End of turn: the weakest enemy unit here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: Winged by Dagon. Her shadow comes before her, and then she does.

cards.name: The Night-Stalker
cards.rules: Reveal: the weakest enemy unit here loses 3 power.
cards.flavor: It drinks the dark of the Shade, and whatever stands in it.

cards.name: Valkynaz Seyth
cards.rules: Reveal: the strongest enemy unit loses 2 power.
cards.flavor: In her vault the moon turns black, and the mirrors keep what they show.

cards.name: The Bound Colossus
cards.rules: End of turn: this loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: The Battlemages built it to hold the Wellhead. The Kyn broke its chains.

cards.name: The Wellhead Wyrm
cards.rules: Reveal: enemy units here lose 1 power.
cards.flavor: It swims the molten deep, and surfaces only to burn.

cards.name: Valkynaz Garoth
cards.rules: Ongoing: your units here have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Clan-lord of the Wellhead. Every Kyn in the Spire answers his muster.

cards.name: Daggerfall
cards.rules: Knight units here have +2 power.
cards.flavor: The crown city, and its knights ride for it.

cards.name: Sentinel
cards.rules: Units here that cost 1 or 2 have +1 power.
cards.flavor: Under the Alik'r sun, even the small burn bright.

cards.name: Wayrest
cards.rules: Each side holds only 3 cards here.
cards.flavor: Its walls let in only so many.

cards.name: Shornhelm
cards.rules: End of turn: the weakest unit on each side here loses 1 power.
cards.flavor: The Wrothgarian wind takes the weakest first.

cards.name: Orsinium
cards.rules: Orc units here have +2 power.
cards.flavor: Gortwog's city, built again in the mountains.

cards.name: Betony
cards.rules: After a card is revealed here, its owner draws a card.
cards.flavor: An island two crowns claim, and both send spies.

cards.name: Evermor
cards.rules: After a card is revealed here, its owner gains +1 magicka next turn.
cards.flavor: A rich town pays its friends quickly.

cards.name: Castle Daggerfall
cards.rules: Spells cannot be played here.
cards.flavor: The court's wards hold every spell at the gate.

cards.name: Privateer's Hold
cards.rules: Cards here are played face down and unveiled when the game ends. Spells cannot be played here.
cards.flavor: In the dark, nobody knows who holds the cave.

cards.name: Mages Guild Hall
cards.rules: Spells played here cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: Members pay less for the lesson.

cards.name: Vampire's Crypt
cards.rules: Undead units here have +2 power.
cards.flavor: The dead are at home here. You are not.
